entries.def:
μεσότοιχον, -ου, τό
(μέσος, τοῖχος) 
a partition wall: Eph.2.14 (not elsewhere, but see LS, see word μεσότοιχος).†
(AS)

μεσουράνημα, -τος, τό
(μεσουρανέω, to be in mid-heaven, of the sun at the meridian), 
the zenith, mid-heaven: Rev.8.13; 14.6; 19.17.†
(AS)

μεσόω, -ῶ
(μέσός), [in LXX: μεσούσης τ. νυκός, Exo.12.29 (חֵצִי), etc. ;] 
to be in the middle, esp. of time: τ. ἑορτῆς μεσούσης, in the middle of the feast, Jhn.7.14.†
(AS)

Μεσσίας, -ου, ὁ (Aram. מְשִׁיחָא = Heb. מָשִׁיחַ = Χριστός, which see), 
Messiah: Jhn.1.42; 4.22.†
(AS)

μεστός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX: Nam.1.10, Ezk.37.1 (מָלֵא), Est.5.2, Pro.6.34 * ;] 
full: with genitive of thing(s), Jhn.19.29; 21.11, Jas.3.8; metaphorically, of thoughts and feelings, Mat.23.28, Rom.1.29; 15.14, 2Pe.2.14, Jas.3.17 (cf. Pr, l.with).†
(AS)

μεστόω, -ῶ
(μεστός), [in LXX: 3Ma.5.1 3Mac.5.10 * ;] 
to fill: pass., with genitive of thing(s), Act.2.13.†
(AS)

μετά (before vowel μετ᾽; on the neglect of elision in certain cases, V. WH, App., 146 b), 
prep. with genitive, accusative (in poet, also with dative), [in LXX for אַחַד ,עִם ,אֵת, etc.]. 
__I. C. genitive, 
__1. among, amid: Mrk.1.13, Luk.22.37 (LXX, ἐν) 24:5, Jhn.18.5, al.; διωγμῶν, Mrk.10.30. 
__2. Of association and companionship, with (in which sense it gradually superseded σύν, than which it is much more…

μετα-βαίνω 
[in LXX: Wis.7.27; 19.19, 2Ma.6.1 2Mac.6.9 2Mac.6.24 * ;] 
to pass over from one place to another : Mat.17.20, Luk.10.7; with reference to the point of departure only, to withdraw, depart: Mat.8.34; 11.1; 12.9; 15.29, Jhn.7.3, Act.18.7; of removal from this life, ἐκ τ. κότμου πρὸς τ. Πατέρα, Jhn.13.1 metaphorically, ἐκ τ. θανάτου εἰς τ. ζωήν, Jhn.5.24, 1Jn.3.14.†
(AS)

μετα-βάλλω 
[in LXX chiefly for הָפַךְ ;] 
to turn about, change. Pass. and mid., to turn oneself about; metaphorically, to change one's mind: Act.28.6.†
(AS)

μετ-άγω 
[in LXX: 3Ki.8.47-48, 2Ch.6.37 (שָׁבָה) 2Ch.36.3 (סוּר hi.), 1Es.1.45 Est.2.10 Est.5.69, Est.8.17, Sir prol.16 Sir.10.8, 2Ma.1.33 * ;] 
__1. in Xen., Plut., and later writers, to transfer, transport (so LXX). 
__2. In sense other­wise unknown (see Hort, in l), to turn about, direct: Jas.3.3-4.†
(AS)
